[FACT] User is expanding their product line to include savory items.  
[EVENT] User is planning to create a new product line for the Saturday morning farmers' market.  
[FACT] User has been doing well at the Saturday morning farmers' market.  
[PREFERENCE] User loves the recipe ideas provided for flavored nuts.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided recipe ideas for flavored nuts, including:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 1. Spicy Roasted Almonds: Toss almonds with olive oil, salt, and chili powder.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 2. Garlic and Herb Pecans: Mix pecans with olive oil, minced garlic, and dried thyme.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 3. Smoky Paprika Cashews: Coat cashews with olive oil, smoked paprika, and salt.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 4. Korean BBQ Peanuts: Spice peanuts with gochujang, soy sauce, brown sugar, and toasted sesame oil.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 5. Indian-Style Curry Almonds: Blend almonds with curry powder, garam masala, and cumin.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 6. Japanese Teriyaki Pecans: Glaze pecans with soy sauce, sake, mirin, and sugar.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 7. Chipotle Lime Pistachios: Combine pistachios with lime juice, chipotle peppers, and cumin.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 8. Rosemary and Lemon Walnuts: Mix walnuts with olive oil, minced rosemary, lemon zest, and juice.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 9. Sriracha Cashews: Spice cashews with sriracha sauce, lime juice, and sea salt.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 10. Maple Bourbon Pecans: Coat pecans with maple syrup, bourbon, and sea salt.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 11. Chili Lime Pistachios with Honey: Combine pistachios with chili powder, lime juice, honey, and cumin.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 12. Balsamic Glazed Almonds: Glaze almonds with balsamic vinegar, olive oil, and thyme.
